```{r}
data <- read.csv("C:/Users/grady/OneDrive/Desktop/EA Games proj/vgchartz.csv/vgchartz.csv", 
                 header = TRUE, 
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```



```{r}
#Selected only games published by EA
EA_games <- data |> filter(publisher %in% c("EA Sports", "Electronic Arts"))

#Removed all titles lacking proper sales data, removed useless columns, and arranged by game name
EA_games_cleaned <- EA_games |> 
  drop_na(total) |> 
  select(-shipped, -vgc) |> 
  arrange(name)
 EA_games_cleaned

#Games Combined to remove platform seperation
platform_merged <- EA_games_cleaned |> 
  group_by(name) |> 
  summarise(
    release_date = first(date),
    across(where(is.numeric), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
  )
  
platform_merged
```

```{r}
battlefield <- platform_merged[22:32, ] |> 
  arrange(release_date)

battlefield
```


```{r}
fifa <- platform_merged[121:160, ] |> 
  filter(total != 0) |> 
  arrange(release_date) 

fifa

```

```{r}
save(data, file = "EA_games_cleaned")

write.csv(EA_games_cleaned, "EA_games_clean.csv")

```
